issues.description: The DOCX embeds data preparation and analysis but no executable master driver. Its first stages save CSMAR/WIND extracts that are already in memory, and later branches depend on vendor tables and hand-built person-school crosswalks. Supplementary Table 5–11 inputs, semiannual/table-specific handoffs and all raw-data contracts remain under review; the package inventory contains an identifier list rather than a full analysis panel. The scanned DOCX also contains Table 5 rotation and Table 6 university, auditor, annual-report, related-party and private-information branches with additional named inputs. Table 7–11 and Table 8 trading paths add CSMAR/WIND return, forecast, visit, fund-auditor and public-firm audit inputs plus unproduced ID crosswalks and change-control panels.

The source trace finds named files with no producer or source/schema contract in the supplied DOCX, including firmauditor_full.dta, auditor_code2016.dta, auditor_code2017.dta, big10code.dta, totalrevenue.dta, synch.dta, fundfirmcodenew.dta, total_share.dta, totalshare.dta, rawreturn_2003.dta, jensen_2003.dta, changeauditor.dta, fundfee2017.dta, auditor_2018.dta, change19902016.dta, change2017.dta, and changecontrol.dta. It also records firm_add.dta and fundcompany_add.dta without a producer, and auditorcpa_change5.dta saved from memory without the change_cpa input definition/source. These are unresolved contracts, not confirmed access barriers.

The source map finds supplied producers for firmcpaschool.dta, fund_managercollege_full.dta, do_full_jar.dta, holding_jar.dta, and holding_full_jar.dta after their first consumers. Table 10 also reads several files before later save/producer sections. The documented blocks may depend on prior prepared files or a different stage order; intended handoffs must be confirmed before building the driver.

The Table 1 consumer at cached DOCX line 11509 names do_bigsample.dta_jar, while the supplied Table 1 producer at line 11465 and the other references use do_bigsample_jar.dta. This is a supported one-token working-copy correction; no edit is proposed against the binary DOCX.

The embedded Table 2/3 output blocks use asdoc and outreg2. The bounded metadata checks did not find either command in the checked Stata adopath, so the exact author commands need setup before these outputs can be attempted.
